source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 6 exercise solved (PDF 140-143): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short and descriptive questions, numericals step by step, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Chemical Energetics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah di gayi hai (kitab MCQs ki answer key nahi deti); short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur tamam numericals ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. Which of the following equations represents standard heat of formation of C₂H₄?
(Kaunsi equation C₂H₄ ki standard heat of formation ko zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Standard enthalpy of formation: compound ka aik mole us ke elements se, un ki standard halat mein, banna (6.3.3). Carbon ki standard halat graphite hai, diamond nahi, aur hydrogen ki H₂(g), H atoms nahi; (c) sirf ½ mole C₂H₄ banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
II. Which of the following equations correctly defines lattice energy of MgCl₂?
(Kaunsi equation MgCl₂ ki lattice energy ko durust bayan karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lattice energy woh enthalpy change hai jab gaseous ions se ionic compound (solid) ka aik mole bane (6.9.2). Sirf (d) gaseous ions se shuru ho kar solid par khatam hoti hai. (a) enthalpy of formation hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: MCQ I aur II ke options mein reactants aur products ke darmiyan teer (arrow) chhapa nahi (khaali jagah hai); yahan → likh diya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. Suppose there are 100 molecules of a gas initially in jar A, which is connected to an evacuated jar B. When the stopcock is opened the possible ways of arrangement of molecules will be:
(Jar A mein gas ke 100 molecules hain jo khaali jar B se jura hai. Stopcock kholne par molecules ki tarteeb ke mumkina tareeqe kitne honge?)
blocks.explanation: Mumkina tarteebon ki tadaad = xʸ, jahan x = jaghon ki tadaad (2 jars) aur y = particles ki tadaad (100): 2¹⁰⁰ (6.11.1).

blocks.prompt:
IV. For a reaction to occur spontaneously,
(Reaction ke khud ba khud (spontaneously) hone ke liye,)
blocks.explanation: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS, aur process tab spontaneous hai jab ΔG < 0 ho (6.12). Sirf ΔH ya ΔS ka manfi hona faisla nahi karta.

blocks.prompt:
V. The calorie content of food, often expressed in Calories (kcal), is fundamentally related to which thermodynamic quantity during its metabolism or combustion?
(Khane ka calorie content (kcal) metabolism ya combustion ke dauran asal mein kis thermodynamic quantity se jura hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khane ka calorie content us ki enthalpy of combustion (ΔHc) hai jo kilocalorie fi gram mein likhi jaye (6.7.1); hazam hone par utni hi energy nikalti hai jitni jalne par.

blocks.prompt:
VI. Which of the following quantities is NOT typically determined using Hess’s Law?
(Kaunsi quantity aam tor par Hess's law se maloom NAHI ki jati?)
blocks.explanation: Hess's law sirf ibtidai aur aakhri halat ke darmiyan enthalpy change se mutaliq hai, raaste se nahi. Activation energy raaste (energy barrier) par munhasir hai aur reaction rate se maloom hoti hai, Hess cycle se nahi.

blocks.prompt:
VII. Which of the following factors would lead to a greater enthalpy change of hydration (more exothermic)?
(Kaunse awamil enthalpy of hydration ko zyada (zyada exothermic) banayenge?)

options.text: Bara ionic radius aur kam charge
Chhota ionic radius aur kam charge
Bara ionic radius aur zyada charge
Chhota ionic radius aur zyada charge

blocks.explanation: Chhote ion par zyada charge ka matlab zyada charge density, is liye paani ke molecules zyada zor se khinchte hain aur zyada energy nikalti hai (6.9.1), maslan Na⁺ < Mg²⁺ < Al³⁺.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. The enthalpy of solution can be expressed in terms of which of the following enthalpy changes?
(Enthalpy of solution ko kin enthalpy changes ki shakal mein likha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Energy cycle se (6.9.3): ΔH°latt + ΔH°sol = ΔH°hyd, is liye ΔH°sol = −ΔH°latt + ΔH°hyd. Yahan lattice energy gaseous ions se solid banne ki hai, is liye solid ko torne (hal karne) mein −ΔH°latt aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
IX. Which of the following reactions has an enthalpy change that is equal to the standard enthalpy of formation of water, ΔH°f[H₂O(l)]?
(Kis reaction ka enthalpy change paani ki standard enthalpy of formation, ΔH°f[H₂O(l)], ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Liquid paani ka aik mole us ke elements ki standard halat, H₂(g) aur O₂(g), se banna. (a) mein atoms, (b) mein bhaap, (d) mein ions hain.

blocks.prompt:
X. The enthalpy change for a reaction depends on:
(Reaction ka enthalpy change kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: Reactants se products tak ka raasta
Reactants aur products ki ibtidai aur aakhri halat

blocks.explanation: Hess's law ke mutabiq kul enthalpy change raaste se azad hai; yeh sirf ibtidai aur aakhri halat par munhasir hai (6.8).

blocks.prompt:
XI. Which of the following processes would typically result in an increase in entropy of the system?
(Kaunsa process aam tor par system ki entropy barhata hai?)

options.text: Solid ka liquid mein hal hona

blocks.explanation: Hal hone par solute ke particles liquid mein phail jate hain aur tarteeb ke tareeqe barhte hain, maslan chai mein cheeni hal hone se entropy barhti hai (6.11.2). Baqi teen process system ko zyada munazzam karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
XII. Consider a reaction with ΔH>0 and ΔS<0. This reaction will be:
(Aik reaction mein ΔH > 0 aur ΔS < 0 hai. Yeh reaction:)
blocks.explanation: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS. ΔH musbat aur −TΔS bhi musbat (kyun ke ΔS manfi), is liye ΔG har temperature par musbat; reaction kabhi spontaneous nahi.

blocks.text: Q.2 Neeche diye gaye mukhtasar sawalon ke jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. Differentiate between exothermic and endothermic reactions.
(Exothermic aur endothermic reactions mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein heat ke bahao ki simt aur ΔH ke nishan (sign) ka farq hai.

rows: System se mahol ki taraf heat nikalti hai
System mahol se heat jazb karta hai
H(products) < H(reactants)
H(products) > H(reactants)
ΔH manfi (negative)
ΔH musbat (positive)
Mahol garam hota hai
Mahol thanda hota hai
C(s) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g), ΔH = −393.7 kJ mol⁻¹
NH₄Cl(s) ka paani mein hal hona, ΔH = +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
b. What do you understand by the enthalpy of a system?
(System ki enthalpy se aap kya samajhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Enthalpy (heat content), H, woh energy hai jo kisi substance mein us ke structure (bonds ki qisam) aur physical halat ki wajah se hoti hai. Is ki asal qeemat napi nahi ja sakti; sirf tabdeeli ΔH = H(products) − H(reactants), yani constant pressure par nikalne ya jazb hone wali heat, napi jati hai (6.1).

blocks.prompt:
c. Differentiate clearly between entropy (S) and Gibbs free energy (G).
(Entropy (S) aur Gibbs free energy (G) mein wazeh farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono G = H − TS (ΔG = ΔH − TΔS) se jure hain.

rows: Energy ke taqseem hone ke tareeqon ka paimana; be-tarteebi (disorder)
Enthalpy ka woh hissa jo kaam (work) mein badal sakta hai
Unit: J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹
Unit: kJ mol⁻¹
ΔS = S(products) − S(reactants)
ΔG = ΔH − TΔS
Sirf ΔS se hamesha spontaneity maloom nahi hoti
ΔG < 0 spontaneous; ΔG > 0 non-spontaneous; ΔG = 0 equilibrium
Substance ki S hamesha musbat
ΔG musbat, manfi ya zero ho sakti hai

blocks.prompt:
d. Distinguish clearly between standard enthalpy of reaction and standard enthalpy of formation.
(Standard enthalpy of reaction aur standard enthalpy of formation mein wazeh farq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Enthalpy of formation, enthalpy of reaction ki aik khaas qisam hai.

rows: Standard halat mein reactants ki balanced miqdaar ke mukammal react karne par enthalpy change
Standard halat mein elements se compound ka aik mole banne par enthalpy change
Koi bhi reaction; reactants compounds bhi ho sakte hain
Reactants sirf elements, apni standard halat mein
Miqdaar balanced equation ke mutabiq
Hamesha product ka aik mole
Misal: C₂H₄ + HCl → C₂H₅Cl, ΔH = −68.9 kJ mol⁻¹
Misal: C(s) + 2H₂(g) → CH₄(g), ΔH°f = −74.8 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
e. Define the following enthalpies and give one example of each.
(i) Standard enthalpy of solution (ii) Standard enthalpy of hydration
(iii) Standard enthalpy of atomization (iv) Standard enthalpy of combustion
(In enthalpies ki tareef karein aur har aik ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Standard enthalpy of solution: kisi substance ka aik mole solvent mein hal ho kar bohat patla (infinitely dilute) solution banaye to jazb ya kharij hone wali heat. NH₄Cl(s) + aq → NH₄⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq), ΔH°sol = +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹.
(ii) Standard enthalpy of hydration: gaseous ions ka aik mole zyada paani mein hal ho kar bohat patla solution banaye to enthalpy change; hamesha exothermic. Na⁺(g) + aq → Na⁺(aq), ΔH°hyd = −406 kJ mol⁻¹.
(iii) Standard enthalpy of atomization: standard halat mein element se gaseous atoms ka aik mole banne par enthalpy change. ½H₂(g) → H(g), ΔH°at = +218 kJ mol⁻¹.
(iv) Standard enthalpy of combustion: standard halat mein substance ka aik mole zyada oxygen mein mukammal jalne par enthalpy change; hamesha exothermic. C₂H₅OH(l) + 3O₂(g) → 2CO₂(g) + 3H₂O(l), ΔH°c = −1368 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
f. Explain why the lattice enthalpy of an ionic compound is typically a large negative value.
(Wazeh karein ke ionic compound ki lattice enthalpy aam tor par bari manfi qeemat kyun hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Lattice enthalpy gaseous ions se solid ka aik mole banne ki hai. Mukhalif charge wale ions qareeb aate hain aur teen-dimensional lattice mein har taraf taqatwar electrostatic kashish (ionic bonds) banti hai; bond banne par energy nikalti hai, is liye ΔH manfi aur bara hai, maslan NaCl −787 kJ mol⁻¹, MgO −3923 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
g. What factors influence the magnitude of the lattice enthalpy?
(Lattice enthalpy ki miqdaar par kaunse awamil asar daalte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Ions par charge: zyada charge, zyada kashish aur zyada lattice energy, maslan MgO (−3923 kJ mol⁻¹) > LiF (−1049 kJ mol⁻¹), dono ke ions ka size milta julta.
2. Ions ka size: chhote ions qareeb qareeb jurte hain, is liye lattice energy zyada; cation ya anion bara ho to lattice energy kam hoti hai (maslan alkali metal halides LiF se CsI tak) (6.9.2).

blocks.prompt:
h. Explain why the enthalpy of hydration is always an exothermic process for gaseous ions. What are the main interactions responsible for the release of energy during hydration?
(Gaseous ions ke liye enthalpy of hydration hamesha exothermic kyun hai? Hydration mein energy kin interactions se nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Hydration mein koi bond nahi toot-ta; azad gaseous ions sirf polar paani ke molecules ko kheenchte hain aur nayi kashish banti hai, is liye energy hamesha nikalti hai.
Interactions: ion-dipole forces. Cation paani ke δ− oxygen siron ko kheenchta hai; anion δ+ hydrogen siron ko. Ion paani ke molecules mein ghir jata hai (hydrated). Charge density zyada ho to ion-dipole forces taqatwar aur zyada energy nikalti hai (6.9.1).

blocks.prompt:
i. For the reaction CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g), identify all the bonds that need to be broken and all the bonds that need to be formed to carry out a bond energy calculation of ΔH.
(Is reaction ke liye ΔH ki bond energy calculation mein kaunse bonds tootenge aur kaunse banenge?)
blocks.explanation:
Tootne wale bonds (reactants): CH₄ ke 4 C–H bonds aur 2O₂ ke 2 O=O bonds.
Banne wale bonds (products): CO₂ ke 2 C=O bonds aur 2H₂O ke 4 O–H bonds.
Phir ΔH = Σ(tootne wale bonds ki energy) − Σ(banne wale bonds ki energy) = [4E(C–H) + 2E(O=O)] − [2E(C=O) + 4E(O–H)] (6.8).

blocks.prompt:
j. For a reaction to be spontaneous, what is the required sign of the Gibbs free energy change (ΔG)? Under what conditions of enthalpy change (ΔH) and entropy change (ΔS) will a reaction always be spontaneous?
(Spontaneous reaction ke liye ΔG ka nishan kya hona chahiye? ΔH aur ΔS ki kin halaat mein reaction hamesha spontaneous hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
ΔG manfi hona chahiye (ΔG < 0).
Chunke ΔG = ΔH − TΔS, jab ΔH manfi (exothermic) aur ΔS musbat ho to dono hisse ΔG ko har temperature par manfi banate hain; reaction hamesha spontaneous hoga.

blocks.prompt:
k. The enthalpy of solution can be either positive or negative. Explain what a positive ΔHsol and a negative ΔHsol indicate about the energy changes during the dissolution process.
(Enthalpy of solution musbat bhi ho sakti hai aur manfi bhi. Musbat aur manfi ΔHsol hal hone ke dauran energy ke bare mein kya batate hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Hal hone mein lattice torne (aur solvent molecules ko alag karne) ke liye energy chahiye aur hydration mein energy nikalti hai (ΔH°sol = ΔH°hyd − ΔH°latt).
Musbat ΔHsol: lattice torne ki energy hydration se nikalne wali energy se zyada; endothermic, solution thanda hota hai (NH₄Cl, +16.2 kJ mol⁻¹).
Manfi ΔHsol: hydration ki energy lattice torne ki energy se zyada; exothermic, solution garam hota hai (Na₂CO₃, −25 kJ mol⁻¹).

blocks.prompt:
l. Consider two ions with similar charges but different sizes, or similar sizes but different charges. Explain how the concept of charge density can be used to predict which ion will have a more exothermic enthalpy of hydration and why.
(Do ions jin ka charge barabar magar size mukhtalif ho, ya size barabar magar charge mukhtalif ho: charge density se kaise pata chalega ke kis ki enthalpy of hydration zyada exothermic hogi aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation:
Charge density = ion ke charge ko us ke size (area) se taqseem. Jis ion ki charge density zyada ho woh polar paani ke molecules ko zyada zor se kheenchta hai, is liye zyada energy nikalti hai aur hydration zyada exothermic hoti hai.
Charge barabar, size alag: chhota ion aage, maslan Mg²⁺ > Ca²⁺ > Sr²⁺.
Size barabar, charge alag: zyada charge wala aage, maslan Na⁺ < Mg²⁺ < Al³⁺ (6.9.1).

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 State and explain Hess’ law. Give its two applications.
(Hess' law bayan karein aur wazeh karein. Is ke do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: Kisi chemical reaction ka kul enthalpy change us raaste se azad hai jis se reaction hota hai, jab tak ibtidai aur aakhri halat wahi rahein.
Wazahat: Hess's law, law of conservation of energy ko enthalpy changes par lagata hai. Farz karein A seedha B ban jaye (ΔHr) ya darmiyani cheezon (intermediates) se: raasta 1, A → M → B (ΔH₁, ΔH₂); raasta 2, A → X → Y → B (ΔH₃, ΔH₄, ΔH₅). To
ΔHr = ΔH₁ + ΔH₂ = ΔH₃ + ΔH₄ + ΔH₅
Agar jor mukhtalif hote to aik raaste ja kar doosre se wapas aane par energy khud ban jati, jo na-mumkin hai.
Misal: C(graphite) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g), ΔH = −393.5 kJ mol⁻¹ (seedha), ya C(graphite) + ½O₂(g) → CO(g), ΔH₁, phir CO(g) + ½O₂(g) → CO₂(g), ΔH₂ = −283 kJ mol⁻¹. Is liye ΔH₁ = −393.5 − (−283) = −110.5 kJ mol⁻¹.
Istemal:
1. Woh enthalpy changes jo seedhe nahi nape ja sakte, maslan CO (oopar), CCl₄ ya C₆H₆ ki enthalpy of formation, enthalpies of combustion se.
2. Born-Haber cycle se ionic compound ki lattice energy, maslan NaCl, −787 kJ mol⁻¹.
(Mazeed: enthalpies of formation se ΔHr, bond energies se ΔHr, aur lattice aur hydration energies se enthalpy of solution.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Hess's law ko pahar ki misal se samjhein: aap neeche se choti tak seedha chadhein ya ghoom ke, unchai ka farq (enthalpy change) wahi rehta hai; sirf shuru aur aakhri jagah ahem hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 What is lattice energy? How does Born-Haber cycle help to calculate the lattice energy of NaCl?
(Lattice energy kya hai? Born-Haber cycle NaCl ki lattice energy maloom karne mein kaise madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Lattice energy: standard halat mein gaseous ions se ionic compound ka aik mole banne par enthalpy change; yeh hamesha manfi hoti hai.
Na⁺(g) + Cl⁻(g) → NaCl(s), ΔH°latt = ?
Yeh aik seedhe tajurbe se napi nahi ja sakti, is liye Hess's law ke zariye Born-Haber cycle se nikali jati hai.
Cycle (energy triangle): NaCl seedha elements se banta hai (ΔH°f), ya pehle elements gaseous ions bante hain (ΔHx) aur phir in ions se solid banta hai (ΔH°latt):
ΔHx + ΔH°latt = ΔH°f
ΔHx ke qadam:
1. Sodium ki atomization: Na(s) → Na(g), ΔHat = +108 kJ mol⁻¹
2. Sodium ki ionization: Na(g) → Na⁺(g) + e⁻, ΔHi1 = +496 kJ mol⁻¹
3. Chlorine ki atomization: ½Cl₂(g) → Cl(g), ΔHat = +121 kJ mol⁻¹
4. Chlorine ki electron affinity: Cl(g) + e⁻ → Cl⁻(g), ΔHea1 = −349 kJ mol⁻¹
ΔHx = 108 + 496 + 121 + (−349) = +376 kJ mol⁻¹
Enthalpy of formation (calorimeter se napi gayi): Na(s) + ½Cl₂(g) → NaCl(s), ΔH°f = −411 kJ mol⁻¹
Is liye ΔH°latt = ΔH°f − ΔHx = −411 − 376 = −787 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Cycle ka diagram banate waqt: neeche Na(s) + ½Cl₂(g) likhein; oopar ki taraf qadam ba qadam Na(g), phir Na⁺(g) + e⁻, phir Cl(g), phir Cl⁻(g) (yeh qadam neeche aata hai kyun ke electron affinity manfi hai); aakhir mein Na⁺(g) + Cl⁻(g) se sab se neeche NaCl(s) tak lamba teer = lattice energy. Neeche wale do levels ke darmiyan chhota teer ΔH°f = −411 hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 (a) When 0.400 g NaOH is dissolved in 100.0 g of water, the temperature rises from 25.00 to 26.03 °C. Calculate: (i). qwater, (ii). ΔH for the solution process
(0.400 g NaOH ko 100.0 g paani mein hal karne par temperature 25.00 se 26.03 °C ho jata hai. (i) paani ki jazb ki hui heat qwater aur (ii) hal hone ka ΔH maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: m(paani) = 100.0 g, c(paani) = 4.18 J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹, ΔT = 26.03 − 25.00 = 1.03 °C, NaOH ka mass = 0.400 g, NaOH ka molar mass = 40.0 g mol⁻¹
(i) q(paani) = m × c × ΔT
q = 100.0 g × 4.18 J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹ × 1.03 °C
q = 431 J = 0.431 kJ (paani ne jazb ki)
(ii) NaOH ke moles: n = 0.400 g / 40.0 g mol⁻¹ = 0.0100 mol
Paani ne jo heat jazb ki woh NaOH ke hal hone se nikli, is liye process exothermic hai.
ΔH = −q / n = −0.431 kJ / 0.0100 mol
ΔH = −43.1 kJ mol⁻¹
Jawab: q(paani) = +431 J; ΔH(solution) = −43.1 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Q.5 mein sirf hissa '(a)' chhapa hai; is ke baad koi hissa (b) nahi.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Temperature barha (paani garam hua) = heat reaction se paani mein gayi = reaction exothermic, is liye ΔH ke saath manfi nishan. q ko J se kJ banane ke liye 1000 se taqseem karein.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 By applying Hess’ law, calculate the enthalpy change for the formation of an aqueous solution of NH₄Cl from NH₃ gas and HCl gas. The results for the various reactions are as follows.
(i) NH₃(g) + aq → NH₃(aq)  ΔH = –35.16 kJ mol⁻¹
(ii) HCl(g) + aq → HCl(aq)  ΔH = –72.41 kJ mol⁻¹
(iii) NH₃(aq) + HCl(aq) → NH₄Cl(aq)  ΔH = –51.48 kJ mol⁻¹
(Hess' law laga kar NH₃ gas aur HCl gas se NH₄Cl ke aabi mehlool (aqueous solution) banne ka enthalpy change maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Maloom karna: NH₃(g) + HCl(g) + aq → NH₄Cl(aq), ΔH = ?
Equations (i), (ii) aur (iii) ko jorne se NH₃(aq) aur HCl(aq) dono taraf se cancel ho jate hain aur matloob equation bachti hai. Hess's law se:
ΔH = ΔH(i) + ΔH(ii) + ΔH(iii)
ΔH = (−35.16) + (−72.41) + (−51.48) kJ mol⁻¹
ΔH = −159.05 kJ mol⁻¹
Jawab: −159.05 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Chhapi hui equations mein teer product ke baad laga hai (maslan 'NH₃(g) + aq NH₃(aq) → ΔH = ...'); teer reactants aur products ke darmiyan hona chahiye, jaisa yahan likha hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.7 Calculate the heat of formation of ethyl alcohol from the following information
(i) Heat of combustion of ethyl alcohol is –1367 kJ mol⁻¹
(ii) Heat of formation of carbon dioxide is –393.7 kJ mol⁻¹
(iii) Heat of formation of water is –285.8 kJ mol⁻¹
(Di gayi maloomat se ethyl alcohol ki heat of formation maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Maloom karna: 2C(graphite) + 3H₂(g) + ½O₂(g) → C₂H₅OH(l), ΔH°f = ?
Combustion: C₂H₅OH(l) + 3O₂(g) → 2CO₂(g) + 3H₂O(l), ΔH°c = −1367 kJ mol⁻¹
Hess's law: ΔH°c = [2ΔH°f(CO₂) + 3ΔH°f(H₂O)] − [ΔH°f(C₂H₅OH) + 3ΔH°f(O₂)], aur ΔH°f(O₂) = 0
Is liye ΔH°f(C₂H₅OH) = 2ΔH°f(CO₂) + 3ΔH°f(H₂O) − ΔH°c
= 2(−393.7) + 3(−285.8) − (−1367) kJ mol⁻¹
= −787.4 − 857.4 + 1367 kJ mol⁻¹
= −277.8 kJ mol⁻¹
Jawab: ethyl alcohol ki heat of formation = −277.8 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
Q8 Using the information given in the table below, calculate the lattice energy of potassium bromide.
(Table printed, reactions with ΔH/kJ mol⁻¹: K(s) + ½Br₂(l) → K⁺Br⁻, −392; K(s) → K(g), +90; K(s) → K⁺(g) + e⁻, +420; ½Br₂(l) → Br(g), +112; Br + e⁻ → Br⁻, −342.)
(Table ki maloomat se potassium bromide ki lattice energy maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Born-Haber cycle: ΔH°f = ΔHat(K) + IE(K) + ΔHat(Br) + EA(Br) + ΔH°latt
Diya gaya: ΔH°f = −392, ΔHat(K) = +90, IE(K) = +420, ΔHat(Br) = +112, EA(Br) = −342 (sab kJ mol⁻¹)
ΔHx = 90 + 420 + 112 + (−342) = +280 kJ mol⁻¹
ΔH°latt = ΔH°f − ΔHx
ΔH°latt = −392 − 280 kJ mol⁻¹
ΔH°latt = −672 kJ mol⁻¹
Jawab: KBr ki lattice energy = −672 kJ mol⁻¹ (K⁺(g) + Br⁻(g) → KBr(s))

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Table mein ionization ka qadam 'K(s) → K⁺(g) + e⁻' chhapa hai; ionization energy gas atom se shuru hoti hai: K(g) → K⁺(g) + e⁻, +420 kJ mol⁻¹. Baqi rows mein state symbols nahi: KBr solid hai, K⁺Br⁻(s), aur aakhri qadam Br(g) + e⁻ → Br⁻(g) hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aasan tareeqa: pehle elements ko gaseous ions banane ki saari energies jorein (ΔHx = +280), phir ΔH°latt = ΔH°f − ΔHx. Lattice energy hamesha manfi aati hai; agar musbat aaye to nishan check karein.

blocks.prompt:
Q.9 Calculate the entropy change of the surroundings ΔS°surrounding for the reaction at 298K :
2Ca(s) + O₂(g) → 2CaO(s)  ΔH°reaction = –1270.2 kJ mol⁻¹
(298 K par is reaction ke liye mahol (surroundings) ki entropy ki tabdeeli maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: ΔH°reaction = −1270.2 kJ mol⁻¹ = −1270.2 × 10³ J mol⁻¹, T = 298 K
Formula: system se nikalne wali heat mahol jazb karta hai, is liye ΔS°surroundings = −ΔH°reaction / T
Qeematein: ΔS°surroundings = −(−1270.2 × 10³ J mol⁻¹) / 298 K
ΔS°surroundings = +4262 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ = +4.26 kJ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹
Jawab: +4.26 × 10³ J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. Yeh system ki entropy ki kami (−208.4 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, 6.11.4) se kahin zyada hai, is liye kul entropy barhti hai aur calcium khud ba khud jalta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Exothermic reaction mahol ko heat deta hai, is liye mahol ki entropy barhti hai (ΔS musbat). Formula mein ΔH ke saath manfi nishan isi liye hai. kJ ko J mein badalna (× 1000) na bhoolein.

blocks.prompt:
Q.10 For the reaction: CaSO₄(s) → Ca²⁺(aq) + SO₄²⁻(aq)
Calculate ΔH°, ΔS° and ΔG° at 25 °C using the following data; and discuss its spontaneity.
Enthalpy of Formation:
ΔH°f (CaSO₄(s)) = -1432.7 kJ, ΔH°f (Ca²⁺(aq)) = -543.0 kJ, ΔH°f (SO₄²⁻(aq)) = -907.5 kJ
[Standard entropy: S°(CaSO₄(s)) = 106.7 J/K, S°(Ca²⁺(aq)) = –55.2 J/K, S°(SO₄²⁻(aq)) = +17.2 J/K]
(25 °C par is reaction ke ΔH°, ΔS° aur ΔG° maloom karein aur batayein ke yeh spontaneous hai ya nahi.)
blocks.explanation:
ΔH° = ΣΔH°f(products) − ΣΔH°f(reactants)
ΔH° = [(−543.0) + (−907.5)] − (−1432.7) kJ = −1450.5 + 1432.7 kJ = −17.8 kJ
ΔS° = ΣS°(products) − ΣS°(reactants)
ΔS° = [(−55.2) + 17.2] − 106.7 J/K = −38.0 − 106.7 J/K = −144.7 J/K = −0.1447 kJ/K
ΔG° = ΔH° − TΔS°, T = 25 + 273 = 298 K
ΔG° = (−17.8 kJ) − (298 K × −0.1447 kJ/K)
ΔG° = −17.8 kJ + 43.1 kJ = +25.3 kJ
Nateeja: ΔG° musbat hai, is liye 25 °C par standard halat mein CaSO₄ ka hal hona spontaneous nahi. Faidemand (manfi) ΔH par entropy ki kami ghalib aa jati hai (−TΔS = +43.1 kJ).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Q.10 chapter ka Sample Problem 6.12 hi hai, wahi data; jawab ΔG° = +25.3 kJ sample ke nateeje se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: ΔS J/K mein aur ΔH kJ mein hota hai; ΔG nikalne se pehle ΔS ko 1000 se taqseem kar ke kJ/K banayein (−144.7 J/K = −0.1447 kJ/K), warna jawab ghalat aayega.
